claim_map.text:
### Proposed Uber payload completeness and correlation

The Uber analysis requests latest, complete trade, fixing-notice, cashflow, and schedule information.
Triggers include booking, market events, trade-status changes, fixing, re-fixing, cashflow creation, and cashflow-status updates.
Each message must describe the latest states for its parent trade.
It requests correlation among fixing notice, schedule, and underlying cashflow.
Its business-event identifier request carries a correction: check trade tracking version and cashflow version instead.
The exact version contract remains unresolved.
Its sequence/timestamp proposals and ad hoc query by trade ID and as-of time remain proposed requirements.
Settlement-instruction inclusion in protobuf is explicitly to be checked.
Withdrawal stamping versus direct cancellation, exception SLA, and error payload rules remain unresolved.
The scenario tables illustrate incomplete batches, amendment duplicate-payment risk, and pending trade validation.
Their sample IDs, counts, and exception rows are examples, not approved production limits or executed results.
The last condition requires trade and cashflow business version/event to match for confirmation.
[Uber analysis](../../../evidence/sources/sha256/d0ccfc41efee8c255ba94ae1ae3bcc6a3337fd605d1a6df52908975570bf6436.md#L1-L50).
